questions.question: Six times the present age of P exceeds the present age of Q by 11 years. After 10 years, three times Q’s age will be 27 years less than six times P’s age at that time. What is the present age (in years) of Q?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let P and Q be the present ages.

From the first given condition, we have: 6P − Q = 11

From the second condition: 6(P + 10) − 3(Q + 10) = 27 ⇒ 6P − 3Q = −3

Since the term '6P' is common, simply subtract the second equation from the first to eliminate P.

⇒ (6P − Q) − (6P − 3Q) = 11 − (−3) ⇒ 2Q = 14 ⇒ Q = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Condition 1: Six times the present age of P exceeds the present age of Q by 11 years.

Condition 2: After 10 years, 3 times Q's age is 27 less than 6 times P's age.

questions.question: The radius of a spherical balloon increases from 5 cm to 10 cm when more air is added to it. What is the ratio of the volume of the original balloon and the volume of the inflated balloon?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The volume of a sphere is directly proportional to the cube of its radius (V ∝ r³).

Ratio of radii = r₁ : r₂ = 5 : 10 = 1 : 2

Ratio of volumes = (r₁)³ : (r₂)³ = (1)³ : (2)³

Ratio of volumes = 1 : 8

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial radius of the spherical balloon (r₁) = 5 cm

Final radius of the inflated balloon (r₂) = 10 cm

 
 
 
• 
 5 cm
 Original

 
 
 
• 
 10 cm
 Inflated

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere (V) = (4 ÷ 3) × π × r³

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of original balloon (V₁) = (4 ÷ 3) × π × (5)³

⇒ V₁ = (4 ÷ 3) × π × 125

⇒ Volume of inflated balloon (V₂) = (4 ÷ 3) × π × (10)³

⇒ V₂ = (4 ÷ 3) × π × 1000

⇒ Ratio of volumes = V₁ : V₂

⇒ Ratio = [(4 ÷ 3) × π × 125] : [(4 ÷ 3) × π × 1000]

⇒ Ratio = 125 : 1000

⇒ Ratio = 1 : 8

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is directly proportional to the square of its radius. Formula: TSA = 4 × π × r².

Hemisphere Properties

A hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere. Its volume is V = (2 ÷ 3) × π × r³, curved surface area is CSA = 2 × π × r², and total surface area is TSA = 3 × π × r².

Scaling Ratio Rule

If the radius (or any 1D measure) of a three-dimensional object increases by a factor of **n**, its surface area increases by a factor of **n²** and its volume increases by a factor of **n³**.
</p

questions.question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 18 days and B can do the same job in 10 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 4 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(18, 10, 4) = 180 units.

Efficiency of A = 180 ÷ 18 = 10, B = 180 ÷ 10 = 18.

Efficiency of A + B + C = 180 ÷ 4 = 45.

Efficiency of C = 45 − (10 + 18) = 17.

Time for C alone = 180 ÷ 17 = 10¹⁰/₁₇ days.

**∴ The correct answer is 10¹⁰/₁₇ days.**

Time taken by B = 10 days

Time taken by A, B, and C together = 4 days

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each person. If people work for the exact same number of days, their wages are distributed directly in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Pipes and Cisterns

Alternate Days Work

questions.question: Ritesh and Gauri have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Ritesh is driving at 66 km/hr while Gauri is driving at 99 km/hr. Find the time taken by Gauri to reach Kanpur if Ritesh takes 9 hours.

Ratio of speeds (Ritesh : Gauri) = 66 : 99 = 2 : 3

questions.question: The product of two consecutive positive natural numbers is 182. The greater of the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The product of two consecutive numbers is very close to the square of the smaller number.

⇒ √182 ≈ 13.49

Thus, the two consecutive integers must be 13 and 14.

Check: 13 × 14 = 182. Both are positive natural numbers.

The greater of the two numbers is 14.

**∴ The correct answer is 14.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The product of two consecutive positive natural numbers = 182

**Calculations:**

Let the smaller number be x and the greater number be (x + 1).

⇒ x(x + 1) = 182

⇒ x² + x = 182

⇒ x² + x − 182 = 0

⇒ x² + 14x − 13x − 182 = 0

⇒ x(x + 14) − 13(x + 14) = 0

⇒ (x − 13)(x + 14) = 0

⇒ x = 13 or x = −14

Since the problem states they are positive natural numbers, x cannot be −14.

⇒ x = 13

The greater number = x + 1

⇒ 13 + 1 = 14

**∴ The correct answer is 14.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Nature of Roots of a Quadratic Equation

For an equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the discriminant D = b² − 4ac. If D > 0, the roots are real and distinct; if D = 0, roots are real and equal; if D < 0, roots are complex/imaginary.

Sum and Product of Roots

For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots is −b/a and the product of roots is c/a.

Consecutive Numbers

Consecutive natural numbers are taken as n, n+1, n+2. For consecutive even or odd integers, the difference between consecutive terms is always 2, taken as n, n+2, n+4.
</p

questions.question: The number 630605 is divisible by which of the following?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By observing the given number 630605, the unit digit is 5.

According to the divisibility rule of 5, any number ending in 0 or 5 is exactly divisible by 5.

Hence, 630605 is completely divisible by 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 630605

**Method Used:**

Check the given options against standard divisibility rules one by one.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Option 1 (Divisibility by 5): The last digit of 630605 is 5. Numbers ending in 0 or 5 are evenly divisible by 5. Thus, it is divisible by 5.

⇒ Option 2 (Divisibility by 7): 630605 ÷ 7 = 90086 with a remainder of 3. So, it is not divisible by 7.

⇒ Option 3 (Divisibility by 14): For a number to be divisible by 14, it must be an even number. Since 630605 is an odd number, it cannot be divisible by 14.

⇒ Option 4 (Divisibility by 3): Sum of the digits = 6 + 3 + 0 + 6 + 0 + 5 = 20. Since 20 is not divisible by 3, the number is not divisible by 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3 and 9

A number is divisible by 3 or 9 if the sum of all its digits is a multiple of 3 or 9, respectively.

Divisibility Rule of 4 and 8

A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits form a multiple of 4. It is divisible by 8 if its last three digits form a multiple of 8.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of its digits at odd places and the sum of its digits at even places is 0 or a multiple of 11.
</p

questions.question: If the 6-digit number N46M37 is divisible by 11, then which of the options below can give a possible correct relation between M and N?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For divisibility by 11, the difference between the sums of alternate digits is 0 or a multiple of 11.

Sum of alternate digits (even places): 4 + M + 7 = M + 11

Sum of alternate digits (odd places): N + 6 + 3 = N + 9

Equating the sums for a difference of 0: M + 11 − N − 9 = 0

M − N + 2 = 0 ⇒ M − N = −2

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = −2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A 6-digit number N46M37 divisible by 11.

**Formula Used:**

Divisibility by 11: The difference between the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of digits at odd positions (from left: 1st, 3rd, 5th) = N + 6 + 3 = N + 9

⇒ Sum of digits at even positions (from left: 2nd, 4th, 6th) = 4 + M + 7 = M + 11

⇒ Difference between the two sums = (M + 11) − (N + 9) = M − N + 2

⇒ For divisibility by 11, equating the difference to 0:

⇒ M − N + 2 = 0 ⇒ M − N = −2

⇒ For divisibility by 11, equating the difference to 11:

⇒ M − N + 2 = 11 ⇒ M − N = 9

⇒ The relation M − N = 9 is only possible if M = 9 and N = 0. However, N cannot be 0 because N46M37 is a 6-digit number. Thus, we discard this case.

⇒ Therefore, the only valid relation is M − N = −2.

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = −2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3 and 9

A number is divisible by 3 or 9 if the sum of all its digits is a multiple of 3 or 9 respectively.

Divisibility Rule of 4 and 8

A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits form a number divisible by 4. It is divisible by 8 if its last three digits form a number divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 7, 11, and 13

A large number is divisible by 7, 11, or 13 if the alternating difference of blocks of three digits from right to left is a multiple of 7, 11, or 13.
</p

questions.question: A train of length 490 m overtakes a man moving at a speed of 9 km/hr (in the same direction) in 12 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take this train to completely cross another train that has is 500 m long, moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 42 km/hr?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed (Train 1 & Man) = 490 / 12 m/s = (490 / 12) × (18 / 5) = 147 km/hr.

Speed of Train 1 = 147 + 9 = 156 km/hr.

Relative speed (Train 1 & Train 2) = 156 + 42 = 198 km/hr = 198 × (5 / 18) = 55 m/s.

Time to cross = Total Length ÷ Relative speed = (490 + 500) / 55 = 18 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of Train 1 (L₁) = 490 m

Speed of Man = 9 km/hr

Time to overtake man = 12 s

Length of Train 2 (L₂) = 500 m

Speed of Train 2 = 42 km/hr

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

When moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = v₁ − v₂

When moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = v₁ + v₂

To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time = 990 / 55 = 18 seconds

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two bodies move towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (v₁ + v₂).

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (v₁ − v₂).

Train Crossing an Object

Time taken to cross a stationary point object like a pole = Length of train ÷ Speed of train.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the speed by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.
</p

Actual weight given (70% less) = 100 − 70 = 30 g.

Cost price of actual weight given = 30 units.

questions.question: By how much is 65% of 65 greater than (1)/(5) of 35?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First value = 65% of 65 = (65 × 65) ÷ 100 = 42.25

Second value = 1/5 of 35 = 35 ÷ 5 = 7

Required difference = 42.25 − 7 = 35.25

**∴ The correct answer is 35.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First term = 65% of 65

Second term = 1/5 of 35

**Calculations:**

⇒ First term = (65 ÷ 100) × 65

⇒ First term = 4225 ÷ 100 = 42.25

⇒ Second term = (1 ÷ 5) × 35

⇒ Second term = 35 ÷ 5 = 7

⇒ Required difference = First term − Second term

⇒ Required difference = 42.25 − 7 = 35.25

**∴ The correct answer is 35.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage

Percentage means 'for every 100' or 'out of 100'. The expression x% is mathematically equivalent to x ÷ 100.

BODMAS Rule

It specifies the order of mathematical operations: Brackets, Order (Powers/Roots and 'Of'), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction. The word 'Of' signifies multiplication but takes precedence over standard division.

Squares Ending in 5

To quickly find the square of a two-digit number ending in 5 (like 65), multiply the first digit by its next consecutive integer (6 × 7 = 42) and append 25 to the end. So, 65² = 4225.
</p

questions.question: What is the mode of the following data? 87, 65, 70, 81, 68, 62, 82, 78, 81, 82, 74, 75, 90, 67, 86, 86, 81, 90, 69, 78, 65, 78, 76, 63, 70, 81
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In any given dataset, the mode is simply the number that appears the maximum number of times.

By visually scanning the data, we can count the frequency of the most repeating numbers.

Number 81 appears 4 times, 78 appears 3 times, and 65, 70, 82, 86, and 90 appear 2 times.

Since 81 has the highest frequency, it is the mode.

**∴ The correct answer is 81.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data: 87, 65, 70, 81, 68, 62, 82, 78, 81, 82, 74, 75, 90, 67, 86, 86, 81, 90, 69, 78, 65, 78, 76, 63, 70, 81

**Formula Used:**

Mode = The observation with the highest frequency in a given set of data.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us note the distinct elements and count their occurrences (frequencies) in the dataset:

⇒ Frequency of 81 = 4

⇒ Frequency of 78 = 3

⇒ Frequency of 65, 70, 82, 86, and 90 = 2 (each)

⇒ Frequency of 62, 63, 67, 68, 69, 74, 75, 76, and 87 = 1 (each)

⇒ The highest frequency is 4, which corresponds to the observation 81.

**∴ The correct answer is 81.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

The mean is the average of all observations, calculated by dividing the sum of all values by the total number of values.

Median

The median is the middlemost value of a dataset when arranged in ascending or descending order. For an even number of observations, it is the average of the two middle values.

Mode Types

A dataset can be unimodal (one mode), bimodal (two modes), or multimodal (more than two modes) depending on how many distinct values share the highest frequency.

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the statistical relationship between mean, median, and mode is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
</p

questions.question: If the 6-digit number N23M40 is divisible by 11, then which of the options below can give a possible correct relation between M and N?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For divisibility by 11, the difference between the sums of alternate digits is 0 or a multiple of 11.

Sum of odd places = N + 3 + 4 = N + 7

Sum of even places = 2 + M + 0 = M + 2

Difference = (N + 7) − (M + 2) = N − M + 5

Setting difference to 0 ⇒ N − M + 5 = 0 ⇒ M − N = 5

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

6-digit number: N23M40

**Formula Used:**

Divisibility rule of 11: A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of its digits at odd positions and the sum of its digits at even positions is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of digits at odd places (1st, 3rd, 5th) = N + 3 + 4 = N + 7

⇒ Sum of digits at even places (2nd, 4th, 6th) = 2 + M + 0 = M + 2

⇒ Difference = (N + 7) − (M + 2) = N − M + 5

⇒ For the given number to be divisible by 11, this difference must be equal to 0, 11, or −11.

⇒ Case 1: N − M + 5 = 0 ⇒ M − N = 5 (Matches the given option)

⇒ Case 2: N − M + 5 = 11 ⇒ N − M = 6 (Not present in the options)

⇒ Case 3: N − M + 5 = −11 ⇒ M − N = 16 (Not possible, as N and M are single digits)

⇒ Since only the first case satisfies the available options, the relation between M and N is M − N = 5.

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3 and 9

A number is divisible by 3 or 9 if the sum of all its digits is completely divisible by 3 or 9, respectively.

Divisibility Rule of 4 and 8

A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits form a number divisible by 4. It is divisible by 8 if its last three digits are divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 7

Double the last digit of the number and subtract it from the remaining part of the number. If the final result is 0 or a multiple of 7, then the original number is divisible by 7.
</p

questions.question: A sum of money triples itself at a certain rate of compound interest in 8 years. In how many years will it amount to 9 times of itself?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In Compound Interest, if a sum becomes n times in t years, it will become nm times in m × t years.

Given, the sum becomes 3 times (n = 3) in 8 years (t = 8).

We need to find the time for the sum to become 9 times.

Since 9 = 3², the power is m = 2.

Required time = 2 × 8 = 16 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A sum triples itself in 8 years at compound interest.

**Formula Used:**

Amount A = P(1 + R/100)T

 
 
 

 
 

 
• 
 
 
 
 

 0 years
 8 years
 16 years
 
 P
 3P
 9P

 

 × 3

 

 × 3

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the principal be P and rate of interest be R%.

⇒ In 8 years, the amount becomes 3P.

⇒ 3P = P(1 + R/100)⁸

⇒ 3 = (1 + R/100)⁸

⇒ We need the time T when the amount becomes 9P.

⇒ 9P = P(1 + R/100)T

⇒ 9 = (1 + R/100)T

⇒ (3)² = (1 + R/100)T

⇒ Substituting the value of 3 from the earlier step:

⇒ [(1 + R/100)⁸]² = (1 + R/100)T

⇒ (1 + R/100)¹⁶ = (1 + R/100)T

⇒ On comparing the powers on both sides, T = 16 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Multiple Rule

If a sum of money becomes n times itself in t years at CI, it becomes nm times itself in m × t years.

Simple Interest Multiple Rule

If a sum of money becomes n times itself in t years at SI, it becomes m times itself in [(m − 1) ÷ (n − 1)] × t years.

Difference Between CI and SI

For 2 years, the difference is D = P(R ÷ 100)². For 3 years, D = P(R ÷ 100)²(3 + R ÷ 100).

questions.question: Given that 50⁰.⁹² = x, 50⁰.²⁶= y and xz = y³ , then the value of z is close to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given the relation: xz = y³

Directly substitute x = 50⁰.⁹² and y = 50⁰.²⁶ into the equation:

⇒ (50⁰.⁹²)z = (50⁰.²⁶)³

⇒ 50⁰.⁹²z = 50⁰.⁷⁸

⇒ 0.92z = 0.78 ⇒ z = 78 ÷ 92 ≈ 0.85

**∴ The correct answer is 0.85.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x = 50⁰.⁹²

y = 50⁰.²⁶

xz = y³

**Formula Used:**

(am)ⁿ = amⁿ

If am = aⁿ, then m = n (for a > 0, a ≠ 1)

**Calculations:**

⇒ xz = y³

Substituting the values of x and y in the given equation:

⇒ (50⁰.⁹²)z = (50⁰.²⁶)³

⇒ 50⁰.⁹² × z = 50⁰.²⁶ × ³

⇒ 50⁰.⁹²z = 50⁰.⁷⁸

Since the bases are equal, we can equate their exponents:

⇒ 0.92z = 0.78

⇒ z = 0.78 ÷ 0.92

⇒ z = 78 ÷ 92

⇒ z = 39 ÷ 46

⇒ z ≈ 0.8478

⇒ z ≈ 0.85

**∴ The correct answer is 0.85.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Law of Exponents for Power of a Power

When raising a power to another power, you multiply the exponents: (am)ⁿ = amⁿ.

Law of Exponents for Equality

If two exponential expressions with the same positive base (other than 1) are equal, then their exponents are equal: If am = aⁿ, then m = n.

Law of Exponents for Multiplication

When multiplying exponential expressions with the same base, you add the exponents: am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 5?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

A number is exactly divisible by 5 if its unit digit is either 0 or 5.

By simply observing the last digits of the given options: 6, 3, 0, and 9.

Only the number 7048030 has a unit digit of 0.

**∴ The correct answer is 7048030.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers: 7132956, 6175753, 7048030, and 6567359.

**Concept Used:**

Divisibility Rule of 5: For a number to be divisible by 5, its last digit (unit digit) must be exactly 0 or 5.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Option 1: 7132956 → The unit digit is 6, so it is not divisible by 5.

⇒ Option 2: 6175753 → The unit digit is 3, so it is not divisible by 5.

⇒ Option 3: 7048030 → The unit digit is 0, so it is exactly divisible by 5.

⇒ Option 4: 6567359 → The unit digit is 9, so it is not divisible by 5.

⇒ Thus, 7048030 is the only number divisible by 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 7048030.**

**__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 2

A number is divisible by 2 if its last digit is an even number (0, 2, 4, 6, or 8).

Divisibility Rule of 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its individual digits is a multiple of 3.

Divisibility Rule of 4

A number is divisible by 4 if the number formed by its last two digits is exactly divisible by 4.

Divisibility Rule of 10

A number is divisible by 10 if its unit digit is exactly 0.
</p

questions.question:
Simplify the given expression.

x(7x − 5) + 7(x² − 2) + 18
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly expand the given expression mentally by opening the brackets.

⇒ 7x² − 5x + 7x² − 14 + 18

Combine the like terms (the x² terms and the constants).

⇒ 14x² − 5x + 4

**∴ The correct answer is 14x² − 5x + 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x(7x − 5) + 7(x² − 2) + 18

**Formula Used:**

Distributive property: a(b − c) = ab − ac

**Calculation:**

⇒ Multiply the terms outside the brackets with the terms inside.

⇒ (x × 7x) − (x × 5) + (7 × x²) − (7 × 2) + 18

⇒ 7x² − 5x + 7x² − 14 + 18

⇒ Group the like terms together for addition and subtraction.

⇒ (7x² + 7x²) − 5x + (−14 + 18)

⇒ 14x² − 5x + 4

**∴ The correct answer is 14x² − 5x + 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It specifies the order of operations: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction. Always multiply out the brackets first before performing addition or subtraction.

Distributive Property

Multiplication distributes over addition and subtraction: A × (B ± C) = A × B ± A × C. This fundamental rule is used to expand algebraic brackets.

Like Terms in Algebra

Only terms containing the exact same variables raised to the exact same powers can be added or subtracted together (e.g., 7x² + 7x² = 14x²).
</p

questions.question: 6 men can complete a piece of work in 8 days, while 3 women can do it in 18 days. In how many days can 9 women and 8 men complete this work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equate the total work done by men and women to find the efficiency ratio:

6M × 8 = 3W × 18 ⇒ 48M = 54W ⇒ 8M = 9W

Efficiency ratio (M : W) = 9 : 8

Total Work = 6 × 9 × 8 = 432 units

Time taken by (8M + 9W) = 432 ÷ (8 × 9 + 9 × 8) = 432 ÷ 144 = 3 days

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

6 Men can complete the work in 8 days.

3 Women can complete the work in 18 days.

**Method Used: LCM Method**

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 6 Men
 8
 72
 72 ÷ 8 = 9
 
 

 3 Women
 18
 72 ÷ 18 = 4
 
 

**Calculations:**

From the table, the efficiency of 6 Men is 9 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of 1 Man = 9 ÷ 6 = 1.5 units/day

⇒ Total efficiency of 8 Men = 8 × 1.5 = 12 units/day

Similarly, the efficiency of 3 Women is 4 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of 1 Woman = 4 ÷ 3 units/day

⇒ Total efficiency of 9 Women = 9 × (4 ÷ 3) = 12 units/day

⇒ Combined efficiency of 8 Men and 9 Women = 12 + 12 = 24 units/day

Time taken = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 72 ÷ 24 = 3 days

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule / MDH Formula

When multiple groups are working together, total work can be equated using M₁ × D₁ × H₁ ÷ W₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂ ÷ W₂.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each person. If people work for the same number of days, the wages are divided in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Efficiency vs Time

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time. If A is twice as efficient as B, then A takes half the time B takes to finish the same work.
</p

In right-angled △BDC, ∠C = 180° − (90° + 54°) = 36°.

According to the exterior angle theorem, an exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the two opposite interior angles.

⇒ ∠AEB = ∠C + ∠CAE

⇒ ∠AEB = 36° + 72° = 108°.

**∴ The correct answer is 108°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

• BD ⊥ AC at D

• ∠DBC = 54°

• E is a point on BC such that ∠CAE = 72°

**Formula Used:**

• Sum of angles in a triangle = 180°

• Angles on a straight line (linear pair) add up to 180°

**Calculations:**

⇒ In right-angled △BDC, ∠BDC = 90° because BD is perpendicular to AC.

⇒ ∠C = 180° − (90° + 54°) = 36°.

⇒ Now, consider △AEC. The sum of all its internal angles must be 180°.

⇒ ∠CAE + ∠C + ∠AEC = 180°

⇒ 72° + 36° + ∠AEC = 180°

⇒ 108° + ∠AEC = 180°

⇒ ∠AEC = 180° − 108° = 72°

⇒ Since points B, E, and C lie on a straight line, ∠AEB and ∠AEC form a linear pair.

⇒ ∠AEB + ∠AEC = 180°

⇒ ∠AEB + 72° = 180°

⇒ ∠AEB = 180° − 72° = 108°

**∴ The correct answer is 108°.**

Exterior Angle Theorem

The exterior angle of a triangle is always equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles. Here, ∠AEB is an exterior angle to △AEC, allowing direct calculation: ∠AEB = ∠CAE + ∠C.

Isosceles Triangle Property

In any triangle, if two angles are equal, the sides opposite those angles are also equal in length. In △AEC, ∠CAE = ∠AEC = 72°, making it an isosceles triangle with AC = CE.

Linear Pair of Angles

When two adjacent angles are formed by intersecting lines and their non-common sides form a straight line, they are known as a linear pair. Their sum is always 180°.

questions.question: Evaluate: (−9) − (−60) ÷ (−6) + (−4) × 9
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the BODMAS rule directly to the given expression to solve in one flow:

⇒ (−9) − [(−60) ÷ (−6)] + [(−4) × 9]

⇒ (−9) − 10 + (−36)

⇒ −9 − 10 − 36 = −55

**∴ The correct answer is −55.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (−9) − (−60) ÷ (−6) + (−4) × 9

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS Rule (Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

**Calculations:**

According to BODMAS, we must perform division first:

⇒ (−60) ÷ (−6) = 10

Substitute this value back into the expression:

⇒ (−9) − 10 + (−4) × 9

Next, perform the multiplication:

⇒ (−4) × 9 = −36

Substitute this value back into the expression:

⇒ (−9) − 10 + (−36)

Now, perform addition and subtraction from left to right:

⇒ −9 − 10 − 36

⇒ −19 − 36

⇒ −55

**∴ The correct answer is −55.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It defines the correct sequence to solve a mathematical expression: Brackets → Orders (powers/roots) → Division/Multiplication (left to right) → Addition/Subtraction (left to right).

Sign Conventions for Multiplication and Division

Multiplying or dividing two numbers with the same sign gives a positive result (− × − = +). Having different signs gives a negative result (− × + = −).

Sign Conventions for Addition and Subtraction

Adding a negative number is equivalent to subtracting a positive number. For example: a + (−b) = a − b. Likewise, subtracting a negative number implies adding a positive number: a − (−b) = a + b.
